'''Trammis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the son of [[Kathos Loof]]. He was a member of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
Trammis was mentioned only in the reprinted ''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]'' adventure that was included in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Two]]''. He was not mentioned in the original printing of the adventure.
